unsupported operator: except: The two-list except function has no list-difference lowering in this translator.
unsupported operator: matches: Regex matches() has no lowering: CEL uses RE2 and SQL regex dialects do not preserve its matching/error semantics, including through boolean equality.
unsupported operator: index: Ordered list indexing has no SQL relation lowering; a relation has no positional order or CEL out-of-bounds/error semantics.
